audit_items.proof_trace: The `EModeRateLimiter` struct stores deposit and borrow limiters as two structurally distinct fields (`deposit: Limiter`, `borrow: Limiter`), each accessible only via separate functions (`borrow_mut_deposit_limiter` returning `&mut c.deposit`, `borrow_mut_borrow_limiter` returning `&mut c.borrow`). All four call sites in market.move (deposit, withdraw, borrow, repay) use the semantically correct accessor with no cross-usage. Per-asset isolation is enforced by `GenericCoinTypeStorage<EMode>` keyed by `CoinType`, giving each asset its own `EMode` and thus its own `EModeRateLimiter`.
